reasoning.why_this_shape: Hand-authored baseline for the Sequencer to improve against. Two decision points (villain call, silence test) and three endings (escape / caught / compromised) are the maximum the Design pack permits: rules.md caps one on-tap decision per episode, Design.md caps 2-4 sensory moments. The linear script (files/story.md) fixes the beats; only the reactivity is authored here.

segments.beat: Meera wakes in the storeroom, whispers into the hidden phone. Establishes the listener as her only line out.
segments.reasoning: No effects — earn trust before the possessed-phone moves start.

segments.beat: Footsteps overhead. Meera whispers. The listener must physically lean in.

event_track.why: The listener must physically lean in. Gain on our own player only.
The room and the screen recede together.
Reads as her pulse, not as a device buzz.

segments.reasoning: Sensory moment 1: duck + dim + haptic converge on one beat. Scarcity is the effect.

segments.beat: Power cut. Total dark. Meera finds a torch.

event_track.cue: CLUNK - the main switch. 'Light gayi. Kuch nahi dikh raha.'
event_track.why: True dark. Touches blocked; any press >=3s exits (safety).
Diegetic: the torch turns on because she found a torch.

segments.reasoning: Sensory moment 2. The turnaround (dark to torch) is the payoff.

segments.beat: Three slow knocks on the storeroom door. The Voice speaks through it.

event_track.why: Sync to audio position, not wall clock.

segments.reasoning: Sensory moment 3. Small effect, huge tension gain.

segments.beat: UNKNOWN NUMBER incoming. The villain calls the listener because he took Meera's SIM.

event_track.why: Decision point 1. Missed call is canon, not a failure.

decision_point.objective: Elicit what the listener knows about Meera; where she is; what she has told them.

FALLBACK.label: fallback
FALLBACK.intent: Off-topic / jailbreak / silence >2 turns / declined call
FALLBACK.behavior: Gracious in-character redirect, proceed on default path.

decision_point.reasoning: Options never on screen. Constraint is invisible. This is the invisible A/B/C mechanic — the pitch's core positioning.

segments.reasoning: The one on-tap decision per rules.md §4. Everything else is voice or physical.

segments.beat: Meera reacts: the listener held the line. Reveals what the villain slipped.
segments.reasoning: M8 stitched reaction — pre-recorded variant used unless M8 lit.

segments.beat: Meera reacts, quiet and resigned: the listener let something slip.
segments.reasoning: Same slot as _grateful, but the emotional weight is different.

segments.beat: 'Dus second. Koi. Awaaz. Nahi.' The story listens to the listener's real room.

event_track.why: Amplitude only. The listener's real body in a real room is the input.

decision_point.objective: Reversed agency: the story tests the listener.
decision_point.reasoning: Only physical input in the flow; no on-screen prompt. Darkness is the interface.

segments.reasoning: Decision point 2 — not a menu; the body is the input.

segments.beat: The floorboard above creaks away. Meera plans the escape.

cliffhanger.line: Kal. Episode nau. Wahi time. Line mat kaatna.

segments.reasoning: Cliffhanger tuned to cohorts that reward loyalty.

segments.beat: The door bursts open. The Voice takes Meera's line. Ends on him addressing YOU.

cliffhanger.line: Toh yeh hai woh awaaz jo meri kahaani mein ghus aayi. Kal baat karte hain.

segments.reasoning: Cliffhanger tuned to cohorts that respond to direct-address menace.

endings.reasoning: Room stayed silent → Path A of the linear script.
Room made noise → Path B of the linear script.
Nominally the escape ending, but the reaction seg is _betrayed and the between-episodes callback comes from the Voice, not Meera. Same audio ending, different meaning.
